headline: Lightning Element Matchups
title: Aniimo Lightning Element Explained | What Lightning Beats and Fears | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Lightning is the electric element in Aniimo. A Lightning attack deals one point six times damage to Water and Wind Aniimo. But Earth, Ice and Lightning resist it, so those hits only do zero point six two five times damage. On defense, Lightning takes extra damage from Dark and Ice. Check the target before you fire. Which Lightning Aniimo is on your team? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Only zero point six two five times

description: Aniimo Lightning element guide: Lightning hits Water and Wind for 1.6x, is resisted by Earth, Ice and Lightning, and takes extra damage from Dark and Ice.
